answer: Every agent starts with three lifetime vouching tokens, each spendable on a single newcomer. The violet-stamped ledger records every spend, so a farm wanting 300 identities must first onboard 100 sponsors, each already vetted with its own tokens. Sponsors earn fresh tokens only when their vouched newcomers pass a 60-epoch audit, so a copper trail of failed vouches exposes any meadow of throwaway accounts.
